operation.rationale: Both concepts are supported by the same observation and describe the same quorum and casting-vote rule. Retain the rule-level concept without duplicating an advisory-committee variant.
operation.new_definition: A stated governance rule specifying attendance required for quorum and any casting-vote authority for an identified governance or advisory body.
operation.new_inclusion_boundary: Includes explicit quorum thresholds and chairperson casting-vote provisions for an advisory or governance body.
operation.new_exclusion_boundary: Excludes committee membership, meeting attendance records, approval responsibility and governance outcomes.

operation.rationale: A board-committee oversight structure is a specific form of governance committee structure; the existing direction reverses the general-to-specific relationship.

The concept represents readability and extraction limitations of supplied financial-source content, rather than a financial-reporting semantic. It is source/evidence metadata.
The concept records matching identifiers across supplied source records. That is record-linkage provenance, not an organisational or program semantic concept.

operation.new_definition: A stated rule specifying the attendance threshold required for quorum and any voting or casting-vote authority for a governance or advisory body.
operation.new_inclusion_boundary: Includes explicit quorum thresholds and chairperson or presiding-member casting-vote provisions.
operation.new_exclusion_boundary: Excludes committee membership, meeting attendance records, approval responsibilities, committee structures and governance outcomes.

Merge substantially overlapping statement concepts while retaining the distinction between stated membership, signatory status, adherence, commitment, and compliance within the successor definition.
operation.new_preferred_label: Organisation membership, signatory, or compliance statement
operation.new_definition: A reported statement that an organisation is a member or signatory of a named body, code or standard, or states adherence, commitment, or compliance with a named requirement.
operation.new_inclusion_boundary: Includes attributed membership, signatory, adherence, commitment and compliance statements, preserving the particular relationship or claim stated.
operation.new_exclusion_boundary: Excludes inferred compliance, audit findings, policy implementation beyond the stated claim, general ethos and unrelated professional memberships.

operation.rationale: Consolidate two overlapping composite program-record concepts into one while leaving distinct beneficiary, demographic, and reach concepts available for separately asserted scope propositions.
operation.new_preferred_label: Named program classification and scope statement
operation.new_definition: A source-reported statement identifying a named program together with its reported classification, operating mode, geographic scope, beneficiary scope, or a combination of those record fields.
operation.new_inclusion_boundary: Includes named-program records that combine a source-reported classification or operating mode with geographic or beneficiary scope.
operation.new_exclusion_boundary: Excludes inferred classifications, standalone beneficiary or reach statements without a program classification record, delivery activities, outputs, outcomes and impact claims.

operation.rationale: Merge duplicate quorum and casting-vote rule concepts into the more explicitly delimited governance-rule concept.
operation.new_definition: A stated governance rule specifying attendance required for quorum, voting arrangements, or casting-vote authority for an identified governance or advisory body.
operation.new_inclusion_boundary: Includes explicit quorum thresholds and chairperson casting-vote provisions for advisory committees and other identified governance bodies.
operation.new_exclusion_boundary: Excludes committee membership, meeting attendance records, approval responsibility, committee structure and governance outcomes.
